reviews.review:
I wish I could give this game a "Maybe" rating. It's a short "choose your own adventure" type game. I like the retro graphics and the overall feel of the game. The story line is interesting enough to keep playing. It has 8 different endings, so a decent amount to want to try again. 
What I found disappointing is that each play through is essentially the same exact thing with pretty much the same outcome until you get to the end. Depending on which combination of choices you make, you'll get a different ending. but other than that, you're pretty much playing the same game over and over, trying to remember what combinations you've already chosen. I would've liked to see branches for each choice that lead to completely different story lines and outcomes. 
For someone who doesn't mind a quick play through with the option to replay all the same screens until near the end, you might enjoy it. 
The game has potential. It just needs to be expanded a bit to make it more "beefy" lol.

I bought this game as part of a bundle, so maybe the other two games are more involved. With the bundle price, each game ended up being about somewhere between $3 and $4. I don't think I'd choose to pay that much for this game if I had it to do over again, for the reasons stated above. 

I do hope the developers move on to create more sophisticated storylines, and I'll be keeping an eye out for possible updates.
